violated_contract: Queue capacity, byte budgets, upload failure and pod loss must never retire the only uncommitted audio copy. A successful socket send or transcript commit is not durable audio custody.
canonical_prevention: Commit unchanged audio and an immutable generation-pinned frame manifest before releasing custody. Queue bounded durable references, propagate storage pressure to the producer, retain failed/cancelled raw packs, and gate transcript acknowledgements and audio sends on the archive barrier. Issue separate audio-only receipts, reconcile source ranges/generations, and verify recovered playback bytes under fault injection.
